substantive_direction_assessed: All nine hinge cases were freshly folded, preserving the original offset L-like four-square polyomino. A correct hinge-axis correspondence reinforces six. To reject a valid remote flap by matching an already occupied face repeats the old opposite-face-to-same-face false-collision mechanism (preset5 missed), even if a different edge is chosen. No independent useful new mismatch avoiding that repetition and preserving fold semantics was retained.
